'''Sig''' was a common [[Gas/Legends|gas]] that when excited, produced an intense packet of light. It was one of half a dozen common gases&mdash;alongside [[Orveth/Legends|orveth]], [[prothium]],<ref name="GG2" /> [[Eleton/Legends|eleton]], [[Tolium/Legends|tolium]], and [[Skevon/Legends|skevon]]<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>&mdash;that was used as a standard [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] by weapons manufacturers.<ref name="GG2" />
